nodes.label: Build POTCAR on the Remote
nodes.rationale: For ssh_detached offload the engine already builds INCAR/KPOINTS remotely but the POTCAR was always built locally and shipped, tying every offload to a local POTCAR library. submit_job_detached now writes potcar_root into the remote config so the remote _copy_or_build_potcar builds it there; machines without potcar_root keep shipping a locally-built POTCAR.

nodes.label: Detached-run Collapse Diagnosis (WSL2 host suspend/logoff)
nodes.rationale: Root cause is NOT the detach mechanism: setsid survives an SSH drop on both machines. tlclab jobs die because its WSL2 host (a shared Windows desktop) suspends/resumes or the WSL owner logs off, tearing down the VM. apl2 (native Linux) runs fine. Fixes: never-sleep power settings + a WSL2 keepalive task.

nodes.label: KeepWSL2Alive Keepalive Task
nodes.rationale: A Windows scheduled task (AtStartup+AtLogon, S4U run-whether-logged-on-or-not) runs wsl.exe --exec tail -f /dev/null to hold the WSL2 VM up 24/7 so sshd/tailscaled stay reachable across logoff.
